parsed.rationale: Regular narrow-complex rhythm at about 80 bpm with left axis deviation (rS in II, III and aVF, positive in I and aVL), which fits left anterior fascicular block. The concave ST elevation with upright T waves in V1-V3 comes with very deep S waves, so it looks like a repolarization pattern rather than STEMI. Voltage criteria for LVH are not met, and there is no LBBB, RBBB, WPW, AF or Q-wave infarct pattern.
